title: Signal / Noise
tagline: Separate a real message from a very convincing hum.
description: A waveform hides a short message inside layers of noise. Tune the filters until the pattern stabilizes, then repeat the decoded phrase before the screen scrambles it.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Signal / Noise. A waveform hides a short message inside layers of noise. Tune the filters until the pattern stabilizes, then repeat the decoded phrase before the screen scrambles it.
